website_summary.name: ChatGPT Interface with Contextual Visualization
website_summary.description: The website provides a clean and organized interface for interacting with ChatGPT, displaying chat history, and visualizing contextual relationships through a graph.
website_summary.appearance:
The website is divided into three main sections:
- **Chat Interface:** Located on the left side, this section displays the conversation between the user and ChatGPT. Messages are shown in colored bubbles, with timestamps indicating when they were sent. A text input box at the bottom allows users to type and send messages.
- **Message Context:** Positioned in the middle, this area is designed to show the context of selected messages. Currently, it prompts users to select a message to view its context but appears empty until a selection is made.
- **Graph Visualization:** On the right, this section is intended for visualizing relationships between messages using a graph. It includes a refresh button for updating the graph. The graph itself is not yet populated.

The overall design is minimalistic, with a light background and clear, readable fonts. The use of colors helps differentiate between system messages, user inputs, and responses from ChatGPT.
website_summary.functionality:
- **Chatting with ChatGPT:** Users can type messages in the input box and send them to ChatGPT. Responses are displayed immediately below the user’s message.
- **Contextual Message Viewing:** Although not fully implemented, this feature aims to allow users to select a message and view additional context related to it.
- **Graph Visualization:** This feature will enable users to visualize connections between messages in a graphical format. The refresh button allows users to update the graph manually.
